scientific_question: Does a frozen cross-site EOG reachability/contraction representation add heldout predictive value beyond a strong response-history baseline, when calibration-only selection is allowed to reject Layer B before an untouched prequential outer period?

target.positive: at least one target-positive eligible event in the site-year under the frozen R1 route algebra
target.negative: eligible site-year with zero target-positive eligible events

partition.outer_state_update_semantics: After a year has been predicted and scored, that realized year may update only the frozen biological source/world state used for the next year's prediction; learner parameters and arm selection remain fixed.

estimability_minima.failure_action: terminal_non_estimable_under_frozen_rules; do not tune, replace, or rescue

baseline_feature_semantics.previous_year_same_site_positive: 1 only if the same site was eligible and positive in year-1; otherwise 0
baseline_feature_semantics.cumulative_same_site_positive_fraction_b: positive eligible prior years / eligible prior years at the same site; 0 if no eligible prior year
baseline_feature_semantics.cumulative_same_site_eligible_year_count: log1p(number of eligible prior years at the same site)
baseline_feature_semantics.previous_year_network_positive_fraction: positive finite-registry eligible site-years / all finite-registry eligible site-years in year-1; 0 if the previous year has no eligible units

layer_a_prequential_state.initial_source_set_for_2008: unique positive finite-registry sites in warmup year 2007
layer_a_prequential_state.source_set_for_year_t_after_2008: unique positive finite-registry sites in year t-1
layer_a_prequential_state.world_compatibility_test_after_year_t: For each currently surviving local distance world, every positive destination site in year t must be within that world's threshold of at least one source site from year t-1. If any positive destination is unreachable, that world is permanently eliminated. external_open always survives.

selection.fit_for_selection: fit both arms on inner_train only
selection.metric: macro binary log loss with each validation year weighted equally
selection.promotion_rule: promote baseline_plus_frozen_layer_b iff augmented inner-validation macro log loss is strictly lower than baseline-only; ties retain baseline-only

final_fit_and_outer.primary_metric: macro binary log loss across 2016-2019 years

authorization_requires: explicit immutable authorization receipt committed after those checks
forbidden: change response route or target after response access
add or remove baseline or Layer-B features after response access
change world thresholds or contraction rule after response access
use same-year target outcome in same-year predictors
use future validation or outer outcomes for earlier-year state
retry the outer endpoint to improve result
hunt a replacement candidate after a scored outer result
interpret a transport/schema/non-estimability stop as a biological negative
